site.tagline: Dependency bumps, checked in a real browser before you merge.
site.hero_title: Dependabot says the bump is safe. Bumpproof makes Kane CLI prove it.
site.hero_body: Bumpproof builds your app twice in a Docker sandbox, once on the base branch and once on the bump. Kane CLI walks the same user journeys in Chrome against both. Plain code compares the runs. When the bump breaks a journey, Claude Code writes a fix and Kane CLI runs every journey again.
site.step_build_body: Each side is installed, built and served in a locked-down container on the same port.
site.step_kane_body: Kane CLI runs the same plain-English tests in Chrome against each side.
site.step_verdict_body: Exit codes and heal events decide: same, UI moved, or regression. No model decides.
site.step_fix_body: Claude Code edits files only. Guards check the patch. Kane CLI runs every journey again.
site.install_title: Run it on your own repository
site.install_body: Needs Node 22, Docker, a Kane CLI login and Claude Code.

site.census_title: Census of real dependency pull requests
site.census_body: Open Dependabot and Renovate pull requests in public repositories, run in the sandbox. We only read these repositories. Patches stay in this report.
